item.description: The External class has issues with handling bytes objects when comparing values. Multiple tests are failing with "'bytes' object has no attribute 'items'", indicating improper handling of byte vs string data in external storage operations.
item.contract: When comparing external objects with values, the code should properly handle bytes objects by converting them to strings before processing. The __eq__ method should not attempt to call .items() on bytes objects, and should properly decode bytes to strings when needed.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_encoding.py that are failing with AttributeError: 'bytes' object has no attribute 'items' should pass after implementing proper bytes handling.

item.description: The UUID storage implementation has KeyError issues when trying to access cached external files. Tests are failing with "KeyError: 'uuid'" which indicates missing or improperly configured UUID storage mechanism.
item.contract: The _lookup_path method in UuidStorage should properly handle cases where external files are not found in cache and should safely generate new UUIDs when needed, without raising KeyError exceptions.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_storage.py and tests/external/storage/test_uuid.py that are failing with KeyError: 'uuid' should pass after implementing proper error handling in the UUID storage lookup mechanism.

item.description: Formatting validation logic in test_black_formatting_error and test_no_black is failing. The tests expect specific behaviors when black formatting fails or is not available, but the current implementation doesn't correctly handle these scenarios.
item.contract: The format_code function should properly handle cases where black formatting fails or is not installed, returning appropriate error messages and falling back gracefully according to the test expectations.
item.acceptance: Tests test_black_formatting_error and test_no_black in tests/test_formatting.py should pass after implementing proper error handling for formatting scenarios.

item.description: Missing import statements and incorrect module references in encoding-related functionality are causing AttributeError issues in tests.
item.contract: All necessary imports should be properly included in the external module to support encoding and decoding operations.
item.acceptance: Tests that were failing due to AttributeError should pass after fixing import statements.

item.description: There are issues with the ExternalLocation.from_name method when parsing names with UUID storage, particularly when dealing with empty stems.
item.contract: The ExternalLocation.from_name method should properly handle edge cases where UUID storage names have empty stems or missing suffixes, preventing KeyError and ensuring consistent behavior.
item.acceptance: Tests in external storage modules that are failing due to missing configuration or setup should pass after addressing the location parsing issues.
